metal_framework.geometry_basis: Shared oxygen in CIF bond table (identity symmetry only); M-O vectors use nearest periodic images, M-M separations use the same bridge images, and the metal-site shape uses bridge-connected unwrapped coordinates. M-M values are separations, not metal-metal bonds.

description: ZIJXOI crystallizes in the orthorhombic crystal system with space group I 2 2 2. Reported CIF formula moiety: (C120 H74 Eu2 N24 O16 Ru2 4+)n,2(N1 O3 1-),2(C7 H4 F1 O2 1-),22(H2 O1). From the CIF bond table, Eu1 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Eu2 (Eu) has 9 O neighbors; Ru1 (Ru) has 0 O neighbors; Ru2 (Ru) has 0 O neighbors; Eu1_2 (Eu) has 2 O neighbors; Eu1_3 (Eu) has 2 O neighbors; Eu2_2 (Eu) has 2 O neighbors; Eu2_3 (Eu) has 2 O neighbors. Oxygen-bridged metal-site graph: 1 pairs, 7 components; largest component is a chain with insufficient metal sites for a 3D shape classification. Computed bridged metal-metal separations span 4.040-4.040 Å (not direct metal-metal bonds). Computed M-O-M angles span 101.15-122.70°; individual values and O labels are in metal_framework.links. Article card reports molecular formula [Eu2(μ2-H2O)(H2O)3(L)2]·(NO3)2·(2-FBA)2·(H2O)22. Explicit grouped units in the article formula/name: 3 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 2 NO3 (explicit grouped unit in article formula), 22 H2O (explicit grouped unit in article formula).
interpretation_limit: Oxidation states, nuclearity, oxo/hydroxo bridging, core charge and ligand identities/counts require article/SI or manual verification; atom-site counts are asymmetric-unit counts, not molecular stoichiometry. Graph topology is limited to identity-symmetry bonds in the CIF table. Approximate shape is based only on bridge-unwrapped metal-site coordinates in the largest component; symmetry-related bonds or periodic structures require manual crystallographic review. Empirical formulas alone do not establish unique oxidation-state assignments or ligand connectivity; annotations above reproduce explicit structural notation only.
